title: Planned maintenance: NBN Kings Park (VIC) network connection upgrade
current_summary: The planned maintenance to move NBN services at the Kings Park (3KGP) point of interconnect in Victoria onto new network connections is complete. NBN services connected through this location should be operating normally.

cause.reason: Planned maintenance to move services from legacy network connections to new ones at the Kings Park NBN point of interconnect.

updates.content: We have scheduled maintenance to move NBN services at the Kings Park (3KGP) point of interconnect in Victoria from legacy network connections to new ones. The work will take place between 12:00 am and 3:00 am AEDT on Thursday 5 November 2026. NBN services connected through this location may be disrupted for up to 3 hours during this window. We will keep this page updated if anything changes.

The scheduled maintenance at the Kings Park (3KGP) point of interconnect in Victoria has started. NBN services connected through this location may be disrupted until the work finishes, which is scheduled for 3:00 am AEDT today, Thursday 5 November 2026. We will update this page once the work is complete.

The scheduled maintenance at the Kings Park (3KGP) point of interconnect in Victoria is complete, as of 3:00 am AEDT on Thursday 5 November 2026. NBN services connected through this location should now be operating normally on the new network connections. If you are still experiencing problems, please restart your modem and contact our support team if the issue continues.
